description: Solve the mate graph and get part poses. Pass code/file for an atomic source-bound solve, or omit both to use the active assembly. Returns { ok, status, poses, iterations?, evaluationEvidence? } where each pose is a serialized Transform ({ translation, rotateAxis, rotateDeg }). Optional `poses` overrides are keyed by mate name and accept only solver-supported pose coordinates. Fastened mates have zero articulation DOFs and planar mates have no supported pose coordinate; overrides for either return `feature.invalid-args`. Supplied source is captured once, consumed within this call and released after solving.

code.description: Inline kernelCAD source to capture and solve in this call.

file.description: Path to a kernelCAD script to capture and solve in this call. Hosted: `code`, `project:<slug>` (head), or a Studio `/p/<slug>?version=N` link (pinned); no local files.

poses.description: Optional numeric overrides keyed by mate name. Only mate types with solver-supported pose coordinates accept overrides; fastened mates have zero articulation DOFs and planar mates have no supported pose coordinate, so overrides for either return `feature.invalid-args`.

name: solve_mates
title: Solve Mates
